investment_policy._purpose: Investment Policy Statement (IPS) used by every research run; snapshotted into run_manifest.json. None of these values limit research depth - research is always as deep as the evidence allows.
investment_policy.hurdle_rate_basis: null = derive each run: hurdle = cost of equity (dated 10-year G-Sec yield + beta x ERP, inputs cited) computed by valuation_tools.py wacc. It is only the yardstick for judging whether an expected return is attractive (IA2); it never limits research.
investment_policy.confirmation_note: 2026-10-12: owner directed no position or risk limits; hurdle derived per run from the cited cost of equity.
investment_policy.benchmark_note: Used only to compare historical total shareholder return; change freely.

notes.text: Stage 1: first launch attempt of 4 specialists failed before start (auto-mode classifier gave no verdict); none started. All 9 relaunched together in one message at ~13:40 UTC; invocations logged once.

All 9 specialists stopped mid-research ~17:00 UTC: API session limit (HTTP 429), reset 18:00 UTC. No reports written; plans, workpapers, calc files, 152 retrievals and a 22-row bear-case ledger preserved. Resumed at ~18:07 UTC by continuing each agent with its context intact (stage 1-resume).

Second API session-limit stop (~20:00 UTC 12-Oct, reset 23:00 UTC). State at resume 05:25 UTC 13-Oct: no reports; ledgers filings 31, bear-case 34; 185 retrievals. Resumed all 9 with context intact (stage 1-resume-2).

Third API session-limit stop (reset 10:20 UTC 13-Oct). State at resume 11:05 UTC: ledgers fin 20, fil 57, mgt 32, ind 47, moat 35, val 40, bear 68 (report started), sps 66, concalls 0 (promise DB in progress); 232 retrievals. Resumed all 9 (stage 1-resume-3).

Fourth API session-limit stop (reset 16:00 UTC 13-Oct). State at resume 05:17 UTC 14-Oct: ledgers fin 50, fil 70, mgt 48, ind 47, moat 63, con 148, val 58, bear 73 (report 306 lines), sps 82; 249 retrievals. Resumed all 9 (stage 1-resume-4).

Validated by CIO on return: bear-case PASS (ledger 5 tier-6 warnings), concalls PASS (0/0), filings PASS (ledger 3 tier-6 warnings). Audit item: ICIL share swap (146.76 mn shares, Q1FY2027) vs CIO-C002 share count as of 24-Jul-2026.

Fifth API session-limit stop (reset 10:10 UTC 14-Oct). Complete and CIO-validated: bear-case, concalls, filings, valuation (PASS; tier-6 ledger warnings only). Resumed 5 with reports in progress: financials, management, industry, moat, special-situations (stage 1-resume-5).

Sixth API session-limit stop (reset 15:10 UTC 14-Oct). Complete and CIO-validated: bear-case, concalls, filings, valuation, moat, financials. Resumed management, industry, special-situations (stage 1-resume-6) on 17-Oct.

Validated by CIO on return: moat PASS (2 tier-6 warnings), financials PASS (0/0), special-situations PASS (0/0), management PASS. Post-cutoff source_date scan: only specialists' own calculation dates (13-14 Oct), no post-cutoff market information. Independence note: management read the FY2026 annual report from moat's _cache copy (source document only, SHA-256 logged), not moat's analysis; accepted.
